raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

DeepSeek-V4.1 enables sequence parallelism when a MegaMoE backend is selected (EP, TP>1, PP1). Every decoder layer then gathers the mHC hidden states before attention and reduce-scatters the attention output through `CustomAllreduce`'s MNNVL multicast Lamport kernels; messages larger than 16 MiB (reduce-scatter) or 2-8 MiB (all-gather) fall back to the NCCL collective. At `max_num_batched_tokens 65536`, full-chunk messages are about 640 MiB (RS) / 80 MiB (AG) per layer, so most prefill SP collectives take the fallback.

On 8xB200 TP8 the existing Lamport kernels are faster than the production NCCL fallback across the whole relevant range (below), so this PR exposes both caps as `VLLM_MNNVL_REDUCE_SCATTER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB` and `VLLM_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB`. Defaults are preserved; raising a cap only grows the multi-stage symmetric staging buffer (6x the cap, plus AG x world_size). Recommended recipe for this deployment: RS=96, AG=40 MiB (staging 96 MiB -> 1.88 GiB per rank). Giant-chunk RS (>320 MiB) is intentionally left to NCCL: the kernel advantage there is <= 2% end-to-end unmeasurable, and a 640 MiB cap would cost a 4 GiB stage per rank.

Why this is not duplicating existing work: #55072 adds a *new* low-SM multimem reduce-scatter backend with a dispatcher policy for the <=16/64 MiB bands; this PR does not introduce any new kernel or backend policy, it only sizes the existing Lamport path (the two are complementary and can be recombined later). #49194 changes NCCL symmetric-memory RS staging, not the custom Lamport path. No other open PR makes these caps configurable.

## Test Plan

Deployment (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 8xB200, TP8/EP, FlashInfer sparse MLA, FP8 KV, SP via MegaMoE backend):

```bash
vllm serve /gpfs/mszn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
  --trust-remote-code --served-model-name dsv4 --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp --enable-expert-parallel \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --attention-backend FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-batched-tokens 65536 \
  --max-num-seqs 96 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --kernel-config '{"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}' --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune
# PR arm adds: VLLM_MNNVL_REDUCE_SCATTER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB=96 VLLM_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB=40
```

Benchmarks on the same server/session, seed 42, `--ignore-eos`:

```bash
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --endpoint /v1/completions --model dsv4 \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 \
  --random-range-ratio 0 --random-prefix-len 0 --num-prompts 100 \
  --max-concurrency 16 --request-rate inf
vllm bench serve --backend vllm --endpoint /v1/completions --model dsv4 \
  --dataset-name prefix_repetition --prefix-repetition-prefix-len 32768 \
  --prefix-repetition-suffix-len 2048 --prefix-repetition-num-prefixes 96 \
  --prefix-repetition-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 960 --max-concurrency 96 \
  --request-rate inf --temperature 0
```

Kernel-level sweep: 8-GPU offline harness timing `CustomAllreduce.custom_{reduce_scatter,all_gather}` vs the NCCL fallback at hidden 5120 BF16 (max-rank median CUDA-event time), included in the PR records.

## Test Result

Kernel sweep (median of 30 reps, max rank; both paths' outputs agree within BF16 reduction-order noise, rel RMSE ~4e-3, AG max_abs_err 0):

| msg MiB | RS Lamport us | RS NCCL us | gain |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 10 | 50.2 | 99.6 | +98.4% |
| 80 | 151.9 | 203.5 | +34.0% |
| 160 | 271.4 | 308.3 | +13.6% |
| 320 | 507.3 | 543.9 | +7.2% |
| 640 | 978.1 | 994.3 | +1.7% |

| AG MiB | Lamport us | NCCL us | gain |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5 | 89.8 | 167.1 | +86% |
| 20 | 263.2 | 299.0 | +14% |
| 40 | 497.0 | 539.0 | +8.5% |
| 80 | 963.7 | 1012.4 | +5.1% |

Serving A/B, same main revision (`b7e0cdac5d`), baseline = stock 16/2-8 MiB caps, PR = RS 96 / AG 40 MiB caps via the new envs; 0 failed requests in all runs.

random 8192/1024, concurrency 16:

| arm | out tok/s | TTFT p50 ms | TTFT p99 ms | TPOT p50 ms | E2EL p50 ms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline | 1251.6 | 1229.2 | 4908.2 | 9.60 | 10965.9 |
| PR | 1375.5 | 1160.6 | 1611.9 | 9.52 | 10872.1 |
| delta | +9.9% | -5.6% | -67.2% | -0.8% | -0.9% |

prefix_repetition 32768/2048/1024, concurrency 96:

| arm | out tok/s | TTFT p50 ms | TTFT mean ms | TPOT p50 ms | E2EL p50 ms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline | 3793.7 | 3896.1 | 5311.8 | 18.74 | 22301.0 |
| PR | 4064.7 | 2553.8 | 4753.6 | 18.04 | 21347.4 |
| delta | +7.1% | -34.4% | -10.5% | -3.8% | -4.3% |

(A replication of the same PR configuration with hardcoded caps instead of the envs gave out 4065.8 tok/s / TTFT p50 2194.8 / TTFT mean 4279.3 / TPOT p50 18.72 / E2EL p50 21385.4. Attribution runs: with only the RS 96 MiB raise, TTFT p50 3340.1 / mean 4700.1; adding the AG 40 MiB raise contributes the rest. A 672 MiB RS variant was also measured and adds nothing over RS 96.)

This PR was developed with AI assistance (Kimi Code CLI); all measurements were run by the agent on real hardware as written above, and the code was reviewed line by line by the human submitter.

+        env_rs_mib = envs.VLLM_MNNVL_REDUCE_SCATTER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB
+        if env_rs_mib is not None:
+            max_mnnvl_reduce_scatter_size = env_rs_mib * 1024 * 1024
+        env_ag_mib = envs.VLLM_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB
         if max_mnnvl_all_gather_size is None:
-            max_mnnvl_all_gather_size = self._DEFAULT_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZES[
-                world_size
-            ]
+            if env_ag_mib is not None:
+                max_mnnvl_all_gather_size = env_ag_mib * 1024 * 1024
+            else:
+                max_mnnvl_all_gather_size = self._DEFAULT_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZES[
+                    world_size
+                ]
         self.max_mnnvl_all_gather_size = max_mnnvl_all_gather_size
         self.max_reduce_scatter_size = max_reduce_scatter_size
         self.max_mnnvl_reduce_scatter_size = max_mnnvl_reduce_scatter_size

@@ -267,6 +267,8 @@
     VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM: bool = True
     VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER: bool = True
     VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER_PCIE_IPC: bool = False
+    VLLM_MNNVL_REDUCE_SCATTER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB: int | None = None
+    VLLM_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB: int | None = None
     VLLM_TUNED_CONFIG_FOLDER: str | None = None
     VLLM_ENABLE_STARTUP_PLAN: bool = False
     VLLM_GPT_OSS_SYSTEM_TOOL_MCP_LABELS: set[str] = set()
@@ -1882,6 +1884,20 @@ def _resolve_rust_cli_path() -> str | None:
     "VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER_PCIE_IPC": lambda: bool(
         int(os.getenv("VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_FLASHINFER_PCIE_IPC", "0"))
     ),
+    # Maximum message size (MiB) routed through the MNNVL multicast Lamport
+    # reduce-scatter path. Larger messages fall back to the NCCL reduce-scatter.
+    # Unset keeps the 16 MiB default; raising it allocates a larger symmetric
+    # staging buffer (6x per rank).
+    "VLLM_MNNVL_REDUCE_SCATTER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB": lambda: maybe_convert_int(
+        os.environ.get("VLLM_MNNVL_REDUCE_SCATTER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB", None)
+    ),
+    # Maximum per-message size (MiB) routed through the MNNVL multicast Lamport
+    # all-gather path. Unset keeps the per-world-size defaults (2-8 MiB);
+    # raising it allocates a larger symmetric staging buffer (6x per rank
+    # times world size).
+    "VLLM_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB": lambda: maybe_convert_int(
+        os.environ.get("VLLM_MNNVL_ALL_GATHER_MAX_SIZE_BYTES_MB", None)
+    ),
     # Experimental: use this to enable MCP tool calling for non harmony models
     "VLLM_USE_EXPERIMENTAL_PARSER_CONTEXT": lambda: bool(
         int(os.getenv("VLLM_USE_EXPERIMENTAL_PARSER_CONTEXT", "0"))
